oka: A former Turkish, Egyptian, Hungarian, and Romanian unit of weight, usually of a little more than a kilogram.
okapi: A ruminant (Okapia johnstoni) found in the rainforests of the Congo, related to the giraffe but with a much shorter neck, a reddish-brown coat, and zebra-like stripes on the hin…
okayed: simple past and past participle of okay
okaying: present participle and gerund of okay
okehs: third-person singular simple present indicative of okeh
okra: The edible immature mucilaginous seed pod (properly, capsule) of the Abelmoschus esculentus.
